turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail: tank with warm water, up to the indicated max level. You can optionally add 5 g of Invisalign™ Cleaning Crystals+. 2. Place up to two aligners or retainers in the tank, inside-up. Do not stack them, and make sure no air bubbles are trapped. 3. Put the lid on and connect the power cable. 4. Tap the power button to start the 5-minute cleaning cycle. The cleaner stops automatically when complete. 5. Unplug the cleaner, discard the used water, and rinse both the aligners and the cleaner thoroughly.
